desc: Nosler Match Grade Ammunition consists of Nosler's precisely-designed Custom Competition bullet along with Nosler brass. Because of Nosler's unsurpassed quality standards, each piece of brass is checked for correct length, neck-sized, chamfered, trued and flash holes are checked for proper alignment. To further ensure our reputation for quality and consistency, powder charges are meticulously weighed and finished rounds are visually inspected and polished.
